prompt:
TASK: Find 10 new corporate grant opportunities from https://fundsforcompanies.fundsforngos.org/.

1) DIRECTORY: Create individual Markdown files in '02_grants/'.
2) FILENAME: Use the format 'YYYY-MM-DD_Grant_Name.md', where YYYY-MM-DD is the deadline/closing date. If no deadline, use 'Ongoing_Grant_Name.md'.
3) TEMPLATE: Use '02_grants/template.md' as the foundation.
4) FIELDS: You MUST extract:
   - Grant Title
   - Organization
   - Deadline (Verified format)
   - Funding Amount
   - Focus Areas
   - Eligibility (Confirm it applies to companies/private sector)
   - **Applying Link** (Mandatory: The inner link to the actual application portal or form)
   - Source (The URL on fundsforcompanies where you found this)
5) ANTI-HALLUCINATION & FRESHNESS: No placeholders. DO NOT collect grants where the deadline has already passed. Only provide active opportunities.

Goal: Build a high-quality database of active corporate-focused grants.
title: Mission: Corporate Grant Hunt
